tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a monotone-concave base-field/sink-gradient relationship, but candidate siphon laws differ by an open sqrt(u_n) branch sign versus mass-drift leakage. A targeted open-branch probe resolves that ambiguity more cheaply than a trajectory batch; no long-horizon probe is indicated at H=0.6.
